Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 47, "heading": "CHAPTER 45. MR. DICK FULFILS MY AUNT’S PREDICTIONS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u047-b0030", "target": "— Дорогим старым другом, — сказал я. — Благодарю вас, Тротвуд, — отозвался мистер Дик, смеясь и в бурной радости потянувшись через стол, чтобы пожать мне руку. — Но я имею в виду, мой мальчик, — снова становясь серьёзным, — кем вы считаете меня вот в этом отношении? — и он коснулся лба.", "source_sha256": "b9d741b6b2da77cd8210bf045010b65e71417b1fefdc8a993e114db7713f93ed", "target_id": "ru-en85-u047-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e223e7c47a15b8c7884ba6713041f5266413fa6fee5aea276f188f8ede9ec27c"}, {"source_id": "en85-u047-b0031", "target": "Я не знал, как ответить, но он помог мне одним словом.", "source_sha256": "df0cc385eae2a3f44f867a98ef95d34c816e7ea4cf1859f4d905f1b385e1b6b8", "target_id": "ru-en85-u047-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d934d2ff1e54d569dbd3c92543c85257cd80d953849a513604b584a2040748a3"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 45, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u047-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Weak?’ said Mr. Dick.", "sha256": "7bd0a1d4b0ccb6ebc22541afaf1da35255c92bd9deeaebbab05563bc4eb2c393", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well,’ I replied, dubiously. ‘Rather so.’", "sha256": "80af6ea49fce99ca63b51830262ade788bbb9136a09088f07c0a2e6abc5f1f50", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Exactly!’ cried Mr. Dick, who seemed quite enchanted by my reply. ‘That is, Trotwood, when they took some of the trouble out of you-know-who’s head, and put it you know where, there was a—’ Mr. Dick made his two hands revolve very fast about each other a great number of times, and then brought them into collision, and rolled them over and over one another, to express confusion. ‘There was that sort of thing done to me somehow. Eh?’", "sha256": "4c9e855f4354323aba94593ae81e8d78e1f118b0a032cce8285662495b2df9fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I nodded at him, and he nodded back again.", "sha256": "a11eb401e0bac800cfb0e19dc15ab2b31e8f95aa1b6f34ffcb43809031725952", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘In short, boy,’ said Mr. Dick, dropping his voice to a whisper, ‘I am simple.’", "sha256": "9f25779ec0d6c44274a37d71c35f04973406df51cff4106fd65087952790dcee", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I would have qualified that conclusion, but he stopped me.", "sha256": "4482af22b216b4b71e5659abe02c70ab1f7c81dccf67a98d4534422857bbce55", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, I am! She pretends I am not. She won’t hear of it; but I am. I know I am. If she hadn’t stood my friend, sir, I should have been shut up, to lead a dismal life these many years. But I’ll provide for her! I never spend the copying money. I put it in a box. I have made a will. I’ll leave it all to her. She shall be rich—noble!’", "sha256": "9c5d74357b3120bd90758755cefe869c3d986e1657a17f35d99395eb95800672", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Dick took out his pocket-handkerchief, and wiped his eyes. He then folded it up with great care, pressed it smooth between his two hands, put it in his pocket, and seemed to put my aunt away with it.", "sha256": "ff5ad61db26de4adb2d45ff02112e89feeed8ec49c60ea2dfa5665e4e07ce46a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Now you are a scholar, Trotwood,’ said Mr. Dick. ‘You are a fine scholar. You know what a learned man, what a great man, the Doctor is. You know what honour he has always done me. Not proud in his wisdom. Humble, humble—condescending even to poor Dick, who is simple and knows nothing. I have sent his name up, on a scrap of paper, to the kite, along the string, when it has been in the sky, among the larks. The kite has been glad to receive it, sir, and the sky has been brighter with it.’", "sha256": "228ecfe34e143206c58553114cae861c0fc9737c701dbeab72700519bfbcbc23", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I delighted him by saying, most heartily, that the Doctor was deserving of our best respect and highest esteem.", "sha256": "03a38c0d7e21f3fad88034323d5f73af8769ff82946e3d30d2e9bebb8fd1ee9d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And his beautiful wife is a star,’ said Mr. Dick. ‘A shining star. I have seen her shine, sir. But,’ bringing his chair nearer, and laying one hand upon my knee—‘clouds, sir—clouds.’", "sha256": "3e522e01dd1699e51614e7c4bf4264c0ace856b9fd22f81d3381058219fd9aed", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I answered the solicitude which his face expressed, by conveying the same expression into my own, and shaking my head.", "sha256": "147a06df3494a8bf737aba97c1859bbd896f1ee5d4ea3f854e9db323a65ec8a6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What clouds?’ said Mr. Dick.", "sha256": "f23303d45ff57afbe326ffaf00365c91d1a7de9c585e7fb3b517b610085ed298", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He looked so wistfully into my face, and was so anxious to understand, that I took great pains to answer him slowly and distinctly, as I might have entered on an explanation to a child.", "sha256": "48e159850fb5687f26ff0015aabf279521033696060db932cf0ee297c38f0e03", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There is some unfortunate division between them,’ I replied. ‘Some unhappy cause of separation. A secret. It may be inseparable from the discrepancy in their years. It may have grown up out of almost nothing.’", "sha256": "f3ccff45f1ec04b4b85acd710013666ec5fb0df38c9d01cccb10f89ef692409a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Dick, who had told off every sentence with a thoughtful nod, paused when I had done, and sat considering, with his eyes upon my face, and his hand upon my knee.", "sha256": "edb6d2c73a23c2272d1c83733063953d12577018124763cd2a73f9196327eb77", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Doctor not angry with her, Trotwood?’ he said, after some time.", "sha256": "fd0702effef2103f926e434e226df722cf761ca2afe9eaa3a08f7a57ab0e029c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No. Devoted to her.’", "sha256": "f34db360b206e9325c3c8b2a361169c6ac0e596b2438ce8cee346fa4f58438f6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Then, I have got it, boy!’ said Mr. Dick.", "sha256": "9969160e6b2972abdb0bfe4de60c6ed2c362e8a28fe531c69910b56e7fb2f6e5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The sudden exultation with which he slapped me on the knee, and leaned back in his chair, with his eyebrows lifted up as high as he could possibly lift them, made me think him farther out of his wits than ever. He became as suddenly grave again, and leaning forward as before, said—first respectfully taking out his pocket-handkerchief, as if it really did represent my aunt:", "sha256": "c8858f582c4c6c02923d5e688b3dd81bb69d4b7e693b960bf714f3c6e1a2a80e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Most wonderful woman in the world, Trotwood. Why has she done nothing to set things right?’", "sha256": "e74dd8af0f4cf2bb41b13e3fa993014ae58c0f12cf40304175846c82efa38b7f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Too delicate and difficult a subject for such interference,’ I replied.", "sha256": "2cbbecb783af577487c27ff1e90fb36d749e1b259a3c7b1e7b45b6bf31ce9c5e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Fine scholar,’ said Mr. Dick, touching me with his finger. ‘Why has HE done nothing?’", "sha256": "4c40e5de7dbc825c78e84e0e7f1b258d56fd29a61d0f87418938479ca1e477f2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘For the same reason,’ I returned.", "sha256": "557084f24c50332121ef35df7730681043060bd98156d7f56e6fd3670f3dc935", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Then, I have got it, boy!’ said Mr. Dick. And he stood up before me, more exultingly than before, nodding his head, and striking himself repeatedly upon the breast, until one might have supposed that he had nearly nodded and struck all the breath out of his body.", "sha256": "e95e2d216793a8023b01589c894977a6a422d84d550b888f10500d4c0dea0a69", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A poor fellow with a craze, sir,’ said Mr. Dick, ‘a simpleton, a weak-minded person—present company, you know!’ striking himself again, ‘may do what wonderful people may not do. I’ll bring them together, boy. I’ll try. They’ll not blame me. They’ll not object to me. They’ll not mind what I do, if it’s wrong. I’m only Mr. Dick. And who minds Dick? Dick’s nobody! Whoo!’ He blew a slight, contemptuous breath, as if he blew himself away.", "sha256": "7cc785a8af0f2beca481607d424c3d8b00307eb5ee85200a7485a1592dd836fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was fortunate he had proceeded so far with his mystery, for we heard the coach stop at the little garden gate, which brought my aunt and Dora home.", "sha256": "3a19f15c4d463e9782f2f3a87077221a889bf851908805e16fe847c16f02be0d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not a word, boy!’ he pursued in a whisper; ‘leave all the blame with Dick—simple Dick—mad Dick. I have been thinking, sir, for some time, that I was getting it, and now I have got it. After what you have said to me, I am sure I have got it. All right!’ Not another word did Mr. Dick utter on the subject; but he made a very telegraph of himself for the next half-hour (to the great disturbance of my aunt’s mind), to enjoin inviolable secrecy on me.", "sha256": "2f7451f6b92402bec16539e0a639def748a7f70351f5973b54946ace878c3d03", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "To my surprise, I heard no more about it for some two or three weeks, though I was sufficiently interested in the result of his endeavours; descrying a strange gleam of good sense—I say nothing of good feeling, for that he always exhibited—in the conclusion to which he had come. At last I began to believe, that, in the flighty and unsettled state of his mind, he had either forgotten his intention or abandoned it.", "sha256": "b058065404ec322f4343d80db2111f051cfddb2615b40e0e6c2ed14db4e749ba", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "One fair evening, when Dora was not inclined to go out, my aunt and I strolled up to the Doctor’s cottage. It was autumn, when there were no debates to vex the evening air; and I remember how the leaves smelt like our garden at Blunderstone as we trod them under foot, and how the old, unhappy feeling, seemed to go by, on the sighing wind.", "sha256": "c2a3136b0d1e48460a48f6395a4e2ddc971206b7d33dcf8674a5b32f18e92d73", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was twilight when we reached the cottage. Mrs. Strong was just coming out of the garden, where Mr. Dick yet lingered, busy with his knife, helping the gardener to point some stakes. The Doctor was engaged with someone in his study; but the visitor would be gone directly, Mrs. Strong said, and begged us to remain and see him. We went into the drawing-room with her, and sat down by the darkening window. There was never any ceremony about the visits of such old friends and neighbours as we were.", "sha256": "0d8e930f8d00553c8b4e9be6800cac2f87ff670c1526a72c9545d94136ba70ae", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We had not sat here many minutes, when Mrs. Markleham, who usually contrived to be in a fuss about something, came bustling in, with her newspaper in her hand, and said, out of breath, ‘My goodness gracious, Annie, why didn’t you tell me there was someone in the Study!’", "sha256": "646faa917c43d5d9ac80def95fd2fe5f6a04c8d3ea299de21e431d56a4d06aaf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
